name: dragonhide
protection_note: A true dragon's hide, tanned: flame runs off it and it will not catch.
protection_price: It stiffens in the cold, as a dragon slows in winter.
lore_descriptor: covered in broad red-gold scales, each one tougher than steel
first_pickup_chronicle: Found dragonhide armor from a grown dragon, judging by the scales. Each one would turn a sword. I am trying not to think about who skinned it.
design_notes: Bridges to dragonscale at F65. Strong AC + elemental.
